messages.subject: Security issues in a tutorial app?
parts:
In another post a security issue with evaluating user input as R code was brought up.. https://groups.google.com/forum/#!topic/shiny-discuss/vzYsLwTFswQ
I'm making an R tutorial in shiny, and I want a potential user to run their code as a sort of quiz

Sharing this app as a gist here so that someone may find a way to "break" it.
https://gist.github.com/rrbm823/7ca49f4aa8c668ad8be0

You can enter your code under the quiz #1 part
You need rBlocks installed to run this.. http://ramnathv.github.io/posts/rblocks-pkg/
Thanks to Ramnath V. for developing the package
